title: Grazing bifurcations of linear impact oscillators in the zero damping limit
summary: We consider a harmonically forced linear impact oscillator, where impact events are instantaneous with energy loss. We study the dynamics at the grazing bifurcation of the non-impacting periodic solution in the limit that the damping coefficient of the oscillator is zero. Through numerical computations we show that a recurring sequence of bifurcations exists between points of resonance.
